forcedForwardEnabled.description: Whether or not the call queue forced forward routing policy setting is enabled.

transferPhoneNumber.description: Call gets transferred to this number when action is set to `TRANSFER`. This can also be an extension.

playAnnouncementBeforeEnabled.description: Indicates whether an announcement plays to callers before the action is applied.

audioMessageSelection.description:
The type of announcement to be played.
 * `DEFAULT` - Default Audio Message Selection.
 * `CUSTOM` - Custom Audio Message Selection.

audioFiles.description: List of Announcement Audio Files when `audioMessageSelection` is `CUSTOM`.
